raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Extend unquantized MoE refit folding to the `replace_parameter` aliases used by already-loaded hardware backend modules. Intercepting only the upstream module misses methods whose globals resolve the alias in a backend module, leaving those replacements outside verl's folding path.

An `ExitStack` scopes and restores the backend and upstream aliases, including mixed layers and exceptions. Optional backend packages are not imported just to discover aliases.

### Duplicate-work check

This extends merged #7987's unquantized folding mechanism. Searched open PRs for [replace_parameter](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+replace_parameter) and [refit memory](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+refit+memory) on 2026-10-28. #7483 covers DeepSeek/GLM LoRA serving; #7986/#8129/#8293/#8308 concern quantized staging or backend selection. None of the inspected changes adds this unquantized backend-alias interception.

### Validation

- Applied the reviewed patch without conflicts to main `2ab35292039a51175a4b3d3b3b2d76e951a0d3e4`.
- 13 CPU cases pass, including 3 backend-alias regressions. The earlier unchanged-upstream negative control produced 10 passes and 3 failures.
- Repeated with the independent port suite against current main: **20 passed in 1.98s**.
- Command: `python -m pytest --noconftest -o addopts= -q tests`, on isolated task-owned source snapshots, with plugin autoload disabled and existing Python 3.12 server packages.
- Scoped Ruff lint/format passed in the earlier reviewed snapshot. The assistant did not rerun full-repository pre-commit on this port.
- Mocks exercise replacement/restoration and parameter identity contracts. No NPU peak-memory, actual Ascend refit, graph replay or throughput improvement is claimed.

### Checklist before submission / requesting merge

- [x] Human has reviewed every changed line, understands the change and has run relevant tests.
- [x] Full repository pre-commit checks on a real checkout.
- [x] Maintainer CI request and real-engine/backend acceptance as applicable.

The submitting user explicitly attested these checklist items on 2026-10-28 and reconfirmed review of the displayed diff. These are user confirmations, not additional checks executed by the assistant. This remains a draft for maintainer review of the validation scope.

AI assistance was used for source adaptation, regression tests, review and PR preparation.

files.patch:
@@ -378,3 +378,71 @@ def test_a_layer_left_staged_by_a_failed_refit_is_restaged_from_its_live_params(
     for name, param in live.items():
         assert getattr(layer, name) is param
         assert torch.equal(param.data, _block_layout(weights[name]))
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def backend_alias(vllm, monkeypatch):
+    """A loaded hardware backend with its own imported replacement function."""
+    module = types.ModuleType("test_hardware_moe_backend")
+    module.replace_parameter = _replace_parameter
+
+    class HardwareMethod(vllm.unquantized.UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod):
+        def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer):
+            for name in self.names:
+                module.replace_parameter(layer, name, self.kernel_layout(getattr(layer, name).data))
+
+    HardwareMethod.__module__ = module.__name__
+    module.HardwareMethod = HardwareMethod
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, module.__name__, module)
+    return module
+
+
+def test_backend_alias_folds_each_layer_before_processing_the_next(vllm, backend_alias):
+    layers = [_FakeRoutedExperts(backend_alias.HardwareMethod(), seed=i) for i in range(3)]
+    model = _engine_init(vllm, layers)
+    live = [{name: getattr(layer, name) for name in ("w13_weight", "w2_weight")} for layer in layers]
+    staged = unquant_utils.stage_unquantized_moe_params(model)
+    weights = [_new_weights(seed=20 + i) for i in range(3)]
+    for layer, new in zip(layers, weights, strict=True):
+        _load(layer, new)
+
+    original = backend_alias.replace_parameter
+    with unquant_utils.fold_unquantized_moe_params(staged):
+        for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+            layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+            for name, param in live[i].items():
+                assert getattr(layer, name) is param, "backend must fold before the next layer allocates"
+                assert torch.equal(param.data, _block_layout(weights[i][name]))
+    assert backend_alias.replace_parameter is original
+    assert vllm.unquantized.replace_parameter is _replace_parameter
+
+
+def test_backend_alias_and_upstream_are_restored_after_failure(vllm, backend_alias):
+    layer = _FakeRoutedExperts(backend_alias.HardwareMethod())
+    model = _engine_init(vllm, [layer])
+    staged = unquant_utils.stage_unquantized_moe_params(model)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="post-load failed"):
+        with unquant_utils.fold_unquantized_moe_params(staged):
+            assert backend_alias.replace_parameter is not _replace_parameter
+            assert vllm.unquantized.replace_parameter is not _replace_parameter
+            raise RuntimeError("post-load failed")
+    assert backend_alias.replace_parameter is _replace_parameter
+    assert vllm.unquantized.replace_parameter is _replace_parameter
+
+
+def test_mixed_backend_and_upstream_layers_share_the_scoped_fold(vllm, backend_alias):
+    layers = [
+        _FakeRoutedExperts(vllm.unquantized.UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod()),
+        _FakeRoutedExperts(backend_alias.HardwareMethod()),
+        _FakeRoutedExperts(backend_alias.HardwareMethod()),
+    ]
+    model = _engine_init(vllm, layers)
+    live = [layer.w13_weight for layer in layers]
+    staged = unquant_utils.stage_unquantized_moe_params(model)
+    for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
+        _load(layer, _new_weights(seed=30 + i))
+    with unquant_utils.fold_unquantized_moe_params(staged):
+        for layer, param in zip(layers, live, strict=True):
+            layer.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(layer)
+            assert layer.w13_weight is param
+    assert backend_alias.replace_parameter is _replace_parameter

+import sys
+from contextlib import ExitStack, contextmanager
 from unittest.mock import patch
 
 import torch
@@ -163,8 +164,19 @@ def fold_unquantized_moe_params(layers: list[torch.nn.Module]):
 
     from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import unquantized_fused_moe_method
 
-    folding = _folding_replace_parameter(unquantized_fused_moe_method.replace_parameter)
-    with patch.object(unquantized_fused_moe_method, "replace_parameter", folding):
+    modules = [unquantized_fused_moe_method]
+    for layer in layers:
+        # Hardware backends can import replace_parameter into their own namespace.
+        # They are already loaded by model initialization; do not import optional plugins here.
+        backend = sys.modules.get(type(layer.quant_method).__module__)
+        if backend is not None and backend not in modules and hasattr(backend, "replace_parameter"):
+            modules.append(backend)
+
+    with ExitStack() as patches:
+        for module in modules:
+            patches.enter_context(
+                patch.object(module, "replace_parameter", _folding_replace_parameter(module.replace_parameter))
+            )
         yield
 
     for layer in layers:
